description:
Short-lived direct link to blob storage, for large or binary files. With path, returns file_url for that one
    file (GET to download; PUT with header 'x-ms-blob-type: BlockBlob' to upload when access='readwrite'); saves made
    with it are recorded under your name. Without path, returns container_url and sas_token for the whole workspace
    (read only from 2026-10-16 19:00 UTC: writing then needs a path).
    For files up to 3 MiB, write_file is simpler.

access.description: 'read' to download, or 'readwrite' to upload (needs a path).
access.title: Access

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

path.description: One file: the link then works for that file only (and saves made with it carry your name). Omit for a read link to the whole workspace.
path.title: Path

workspace_id.description: The workspace's id (a UUID), from create_workspace, list_workspaces or the store.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: get_file_link
